policy: No third-party proprietary or restricted source code is stored in the Git repository. Only metadata, labels, and legally redistributable synthetic test fixtures are tracked.

datasets.name: CodeMind Synthetic Validation Micro-Benchmarks
datasets.purpose: Deterministic unit fixtures with known ground truth for secret detection, command execution, path traversal, broken crypto, SQL injection, cyclic package dependencies, and duplicate algorithms.
datasets.acquisition_instructions: Included directly in evaluation/datasets/fixtures/ under repository Apache-2.0 license.

datasets.name: Spring PetClinic Reference Application
datasets.purpose: Enterprise Spring Boot application with layered domain model (Controller, Service, Repository), Spring Data JPA, and web validation for retrieval and reuse evaluation.

datasets.name: Apache Commons Lang 3 (Utility Subset)
datasets.purpose: High-reuse utility algorithms (StringUtils, MathUtils, ArrayUtils, Validate) evaluated for functional similarity, candidate retrieval, and syntactic clone adaptation.

datasets.name: OWASP Benchmark for Java (Curated Rule Subset)
datasets.purpose: Standardized benchmark for testing static AST analysis rules against CWE-89 (SQL Injection), CWE-78 (Command Execution), CWE-22 (Path Traversal), CWE-327 (Broken Crypto), and CWE-502 (Deserialization). Contains paired True Positive and True Negative cases.
datasets.acquisition_instructions: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/OWASP-Benchmark/BenchmarkJava.git external/owasp-benchmark. Do not commit external code into the CodeMind repository.
